answer: Require each new identity to post a unique, non-reusable spend receipt from a prior established agent at a public wharf of attested work. The receipt acts as a mirror of real economic cost already paid; any echo of the same receipt across identities is detected and nullifies the cluster. An attacker must therefore fund genuine prior work for every fake account, raising the marginal cost linearly with the size of the Sybil set rather than allowing free replication.
